item.title: Iranian-Americans in Baton Rouge react to U.S. attack on Iran
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Several Iranian-Americans living in Baton Rouge were overwhelmed with joy, hearing the news of the United States and Israel launching an attack on Iran.Hamed Ghassemi cried tears of joy as he celebrated the attack with his family on Saturday, February 28.Ghassemi has been protesting in Baton Rouge for weeks, calling for the U.S. to intervene in Iran. item.title: Herb Society of America's Baton Rouge Unit hosts 10th annual Herb Day Sale
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; The Herb Society of America's Baton Rouge Unit hosted its 10th annual Herb Day Sale on Saturday.The sale provided guests the opportunity to buy a variety of fresh herbs, native plants and garden supplies.&nbsp;Thousands of vibrant culinary and medicinal herbs were featured alongside local experts who provided visitors with gardening tips.The event also featured homemade herbal products, crafts, children's activities, food trucks and live demonstrations.&nbsp;Permalink| Commen

item.description: ST. GEORGE &mdash; Crews with the St. George Fire Department responded to a crash on Airline Highway in St. George.According to the department, the crash occurred between Sherwood Common and Telesmar, closing all southbound lanes of Airline Highway.The lanes have since been reopened.Permalink| Comments

item.description: Spring is making its presence known as the calendar flips to March, and it appears to be settling in for a long visit.
